bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Lundstrum Center for the Performing Arts.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LUNDSTRUM CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for grants to the Lundstrum Center for the Performing Arts for after-school educational programming that includes instruction in dance, voice, and drama. Up to .... percent of the grants may be used for capital improvements. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Lundstrum Center for the Performing Arts.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LUNDSTRUM CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for grants to the Lundstrum Center for the Performing Arts for after-school educational programming that includes instruction in dance, voice, and drama. Up to .... percent of the grants may be used for capital improvements.
